title: Work on a Ticket
subtitle: A day of an analyst in Sentinel Aura

outro.title: That's the loop
outro.subtitle: Find your Tickets, understand them, record what you learn, and trace every change.

steps.caption: Open the view Assigned to me
steps.narration: Analysts land on the New view, the queue of new Tickets. The view Assigned to me lists the Tickets that are yours.

steps.caption: The attention summary counts the urgent work
steps.narration: Next to the heading, the attention summary counts the active P1 Tickets, the embargoes that have expired, and the deliveries that are overdue, by phase.

steps.caption: Each row shows its next deadline
steps.narration: In the list, the Deadline column shows the next deadline of each Ticket, in red once it has passed.

steps.caption: Open the Ticket
steps.narration: Open the Ticket from its identifier.

steps.caption: Select the priority to see why
steps.narration: The priority in the heading explains itself: select it.

steps.caption: Who set it, when, and what Sentinel computed
steps.narration: This priority is an override: the explanation says who set it and when, and the priority that Sentinel computed from the evidence.

steps.caption: Press Escape to close it
steps.narration: Press Escape to close the explanation.

steps.caption: Open the tab References
steps.narration: The tab References lists the advisories, patches, and reports that analysts read about the Ticket.

steps.caption: Select Add reference
steps.narration: To record a new one, select Add reference.

steps.caption: Paste its address
steps.narration: Paste the address of the page.

steps.caption: Give it a title
steps.narration: A title is optional, and makes the reference easier to find. Sentinel detects its type from the address.

steps.caption: Add it to the Ticket
steps.narration: Select Add reference in the dialog.

steps.caption: The reference is on the Ticket
steps.narration: The new reference shows in the table, as a manual reference, with its type and the time it was added.

steps.caption: Open the tab Audit log
steps.narration: The tab Audit log keeps every change of the Ticket, and what Sentinel did by itself.

steps.caption: Your change is the latest event
steps.narration: The reference that you added is the latest event, with who added it and when.
